newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse ordered to monitor foreign ownership.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse ordered to monitor foreign ownership.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Thursday it had told the stock exchange to develop a system that will immediately determine the level of foreign ownership in companies, the SEC said on Thursday.
"We direct your organisation to draw up an effective and transparent monitoring system," SEC Chairman Perfecto Yasay said in a memorandum to the exchange.
At present, it is diffiult to tell when a company has reacvhed its foreign ownership ceiling.
Philippine law limits foreigners ot 40 percent of local firms, with the exception of media and retail companies which are completely barred to them.
Yasay directed the Philippine Central Depository Inc and the Philippine Association of Stock Transfer Agents to help the exchange develop the required monitoring system.
